customer_question: How do we log in to the SIG Bluetooth Launchstudio / Qualification Workspace? The login field used to ask for a username but now it asks for an email address.
question_variants: SIG Launchstudio login page changed — username no longer works
Where do I enter my credentials on the new SIG portal?
SIG portal login changed from username to email address
actual_issue: The SIG Launchstudio portal updated its authentication flow: the login credential field changed from 'User Name' to 'Email Address'. Users who previously entered their SIG account username were confused by the new UI.
plain_english_explanation: SIG changed the Launchstudio login from a username field to an email address field. You now log in with the email address registered to your SIG member account, not a separate username.
consultant_answer: Log in with the email address associated with the SIG member account rather than a username. The field label changed but the underlying account is the same.
decision_logic: SIG periodically updates the Qualification Workspace / Launchstudio UI. This change only affected the label and input format of the login credential — the account itself is unchanged. Email is now the primary identifier.
final_recommendation: When helping customers log in to SIG Launchstudio, confirm they are entering their registered SIG account email address, not a legacy username.
risk_if_done_wrong: Customers may be unable to log in or may reset credentials unnecessarily, delaying project start.
